fire.balance: When balanced, your fire feels confident, inspired, and ready to act without burning out.
fire.imbalance: Too much fire can feel impulsive or restless; too little can feel unmotivated or flat.
tips: Move your body for 10 minutes to spark momentum.
Pick one bold action and do it today.
Spend time in sunlight or warm colors to recharge.

earth.balance: When balanced, your earth feels steady, practical, and deeply rooted.
earth.imbalance: Too much earth can feel rigid or stuck; too little can feel scattered or insecure.
tips: Declutter one small area to restore calm.
Eat a nourishing meal and slow down while you do.
Take a short walk and notice textures under your feet.

air.balance: When balanced, your air feels clear, curious, and socially light.
air.imbalance: Too much air can feel anxious or overthinking; too little can feel uninspired.
tips: Write down three thoughts to clear mental noise.
Open a window or step outside for fresh air.
Have one meaningful conversation to reconnect.

water.balance: When balanced, your water feels intuitive, compassionate, and flowing.
water.imbalance: Too much water can feel overwhelming or moody; too little can feel disconnected.
tips: Take a warm shower or bath to reset your mood.
Listen to a calming song and let feelings move through.
Journal one page to release what you are holding.
